title: Harness connection
text: Only live machines owned by the viewer appear in the setup checklist, newest activity first. Registry retirement removes a machine from setup requirements; relay and session history enrich registered machines without adding identities. Onboarding and machine detail share surface-specific relay installation observations. Family configuration never proves a desktop app or extension is installed; unsupported detection reads not observed. Hook trust and session activity remain configuration and readiness facts. Setup manages existing harness homes independently of installation; CLI readiness uses the shared PATH and bundled-executable resolver without a desktop inventory scan.
